name: Gathering nodes from Ascension GatherMate2 data spawn where the addon recorded them
contract: rev_20261027_60_coa_gathermate_nodes places herb, ore, tree and fishing nodes at the Ascension GatherMate2 positions, converted to world coordinates and server heights, in pools of about a third of each 200 yd area. A lone Silverleaf 1617 spot in Westfall (spawn 12001169, pool 20000257 with one member) is always active, so it is spawned on the map once a player is there.

steps.label: the Silverleaf spot from the addon data is spawned
